messages:
Ben T: Starting quick sync for Aurelia Finance POC — they need KMS in their AWS account, VPC peering, and clear SLOs for latency/cost/accuracy. Can we map next 3 weeks?
Nina P: Customer requirements: p50 <= 200ms, p95 <= 600ms for up to 1024 tokens; target 50 rps sustained, 200 rps burst; cost target ~ $0.16 / 1k tokens for POC. They also asked for per-call tag headers and per-route cost breakdown.
Omar S: 1024 tokens changes perf profile; for quantized 13B p50 ~150-250ms depending on seq distribution, p95 can spike. Mistral/7B variants hit latency easily but may drop on structured accuracy. Need eval prompts + explicit acceptance thresholds (EM / semantic sim).
Ravi (ops): Security: KMS in-customer-account supported via cross-account role, HSM via partner engagement; Private deployment available if required. Need Legal on export-control and data residency. They requested zero-log mode — ops note: we can support but need to confirm audit trail constraints.
Ben T: They prefer no logs retained. That's stricter than usual — flagging Legal. Proposed timeline: fast 2-week POC: Week1 infra + data ingest + onboarding; Week2 evals, tuning, acceptance call.
Nina P: Eval scope: ~3k prompts + ~300 human spot-checks, deterministic runs with fixed seeds. They want exact-match for structured fields where applicable.
Omar S: Eval runner example: ```bash
redwood eval run --model rwd-13b-quant --batch 16 --max-tokens 1024 --seed 42 --enable-prefix-cache
``` We'll attach the full config and sampling seeds.
deploy-bot: Provisioning cluster 'aurelia-poc-1' in us-west-2 (g5.2xlarge), estimated ready in ~22m.
Ravi (ops): Burn estimate (rough): assume avg request 600 tokens. For a 2h sustained test at 50 rps -> ~216M tokens -> at $0.16/1k ≈ $34.6k. With caching and sampling we often see effective tokens drop ~80% -> ~ $6.9k. We'll present both conservative and optimized scenarios.
Ben T: Draft acceptance checklist:
- Latency: p50 <= 200ms, p95 <= 600ms (requests ≤1024 tokens)
- Throughput: 50 rps sustained, 200 rps burst (burst window <=30s)
- Quality: structured EM >= 70%, semantic sim >= 0.78 aggregated, manual pass rate >= 88%
- Cost: POC average <= $0.18 / 1k tokens
- Security: customer-managed KMS (cross-account), optional HSM, zero-log opt-in or max 7-day retention, SOC2/ISO availability
- Ops: per-request tracing + cost tags, export traces to customer's Datadog/Snowflake, retry/backoff policy documented
- Reliability: fallback to smaller quant variant if latency targets missed >5m; canary gating for production rollouts
Nina P: I'll confirm whether zero-logs is firm or if 7-day retention is acceptable for audits — will check with Aurelia infra lead and Legal.
Omar S: Action items: 1) I'll run perf matrix on 7B vs 13B quant variants (latency/throughput/cost) and share numbers (48h). 2) Ravi to produce cross-account IAM + KMS onboarding doc and HSM note (EOD). 3) Ben to confirm acceptance wording and final cost target with customer (today).
Ben T: I'll schedule Thursday 09:00 PT acceptance walkthrough with Aurelia and include their infra lead. Thanks all :thumbsup:
